milestones.title: M0 — Foundation and contracts
milestones.description: Stable interfaces, authenticated access and a shared development workflow.

milestones.title: M1 — Live telemetry loop
milestones.description: One real or simulated device reaches the dashboard through the complete data path.

milestones.title: M2 — Safe command loop
milestones.description: A user command is validated, delivered and visibly acknowledged.

milestones.title: M3 — Simulation and optimization
milestones.description: A reproducible scenario compares manual control against feasible scheduling.

milestones.title: M4 — Hackathon demo
milestones.description: Deployment, rehearsal, backup path and a credible presentation.

milestones.title: M5 — Stretch goals
milestones.description: Optional work after the core demo is complete.

issues.title: Freeze telemetry, MQTT and command contracts
issues.body:
Agree the boundaries before parallel feature work.

Suggested coordination: Jordan, Daniel, Stoyan and Mitko. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Validate the example telemetry against the exported v1 schema.
- [ ] Agree topic ACLs, units, sign conventions, device capabilities, stale-data windows and payload/rate limits.
- [ ] Write command and acknowledgement schemas with idempotency, expiry, ranges and device failure cases.
- [ ] Agree versioned WebSocket events and optimizer inputs/outputs.

Start a short-lived feature/contracts branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Implement Supabase Auth and site authorization
issues.body:
Private telemetry and controls require tenant isolation before public deployment.

Suggested coordination: Jordan and Stoyan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Validate JWT signature, issuer, audience and expiry; do not authorize from user-editable metadata.
- [ ] Protect REST, WebSocket and commands with site membership/role checks.
- [ ] Keep service secrets in backend environments and keep the application schema out of the Data API.
- [ ] Test unauthenticated access and cross-site reads/writes/subscriptions.

Start a short-lived feature/auth branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Implement site/device registry and measurement history
issues.body:
Build authorized queries on the existing ORM foundation.

Suggested coordination: Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Expose site/device reads scoped to the current user.
- [ ] Add device provisioning, capabilities and configured operating limits.
- [ ] Provide bounded UTC history queries with pagination and indexes.
- [ ] Return empty, missing and unauthorized states clearly.

Start a short-lived feature/registry branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Ingest authenticated MQTT telemetry into PostgreSQL
issues.body:
Complete the first device-to-database path.

Suggested coordination: Jordan and Daniel. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Run a persistent subscriber with reconnect/backoff and per-device broker ACLs.
- [ ] Validate topic/payload IDs, capability, timestamp freshness and the telemetry schema.
- [ ] Handle duplicate message_id safely; persist before notifying clients.
- [ ] Show real and simulated devices using the same adapter-independent model.

Start a short-lived feature/mqtt branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Stream authorized site events over WebSocket
issues.body:
Turn persisted observations into live client updates.

Suggested coordination: Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Authorize site subscriptions before accepting them.
- [ ] Bound subscriber queues and disconnect slow consumers safely.
- [ ] Implement heartbeat, reconnect and REST snapshot recovery.
- [ ] Demonstrate one backend instance; document the shared-fan-out requirement for multiple workers.

Start a short-lived feature/websocket branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Build the first live energy dashboard
issues.body:
Make the data path visible with a focused, readable product screen.

Suggested coordination: Stoyan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Show solar, signed grid flow, load, battery SOC and device freshness.
- [ ] Use real API/WebSocket values and explicit loading/empty/error/offline states.
- [ ] Keep charts and flow units consistent; show costs only when tariff/energy inputs exist.
- [ ] Verify mobile layout, keyboard access and reconnect recovery.

Start a short-lived feature/dashboard branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Persist and validate device commands
issues.body:
A command must have an auditable result rather than a publish-only success message.

Suggested coordination: Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Add a command migration and authenticated command API.
- [ ] Check tenant/role, capability, operating range, interlock, manual override and expiry.
- [ ] Persist pending/published/applied/failed/expired with command_id and requested_by.
- [ ] Test duplicates, expired commands, no acknowledgement and invalid device limits.

Start a short-lived feature/command-service branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Apply and acknowledge one ESP32 demo command
issues.body:
Close the reverse path with a safe controllable demo load.

Suggested coordination: Daniel and Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Consume non-retained MQTT commands and deduplicate command_id.
- [ ] Reject expired commands and unsafe limits locally as well as in the API.
- [ ] Return applied/failed acknowledgement and read back the resulting state.
- [ ] Demonstrate network-loss/manual-override behavior on a low-voltage load.

Start a short-lived feature/hardware-command branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Add Monitor and Assist controls with visible command results
issues.body:
Give the user a trustworthy way to apply a recommendation.

Suggested coordination: Stoyan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Monitor stays read-only; Assist explicitly applies a proposal.
- [ ] Render command pending/applied/failed/expired states and manual overrides.
- [ ] Disable controls without matching capability/permission or for stale devices.
- [ ] Keep hardware Autopilot disabled until its failure handling passes.

Start a short-lived feature/assist branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Build a deterministic office energy simulator
issues.body:
Provide a reproducible fallback and a fair comparison scenario.

Suggested coordination: Stoyan, Jordan and Mitko. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Model solar, grid, battery, HVAC and an initial small EV/charger scenario; expand to 10 EVs/3 chargers only after feasibility checks.
- [ ] Use fixed seed, UTC intervals, consistent W/Wh units and the shared telemetry contract.
- [ ] Conserve energy with battery efficiency/SOC bounds, charger capacity, EV arrivals/departures and comfort constraints.
- [ ] Support reset/replay and test energy balance and infeasible demand.

Start a short-lived feature/simulator branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Add documented solar/load forecasts and tariffs
issues.body:
Use transparent demo inputs before introducing learned forecasting.

Suggested coordination: Mitko and Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Expose interval forecasts and import/export tariffs with timezone and currency.
- [ ] Mark forecasts separately from measurements and show assumptions.
- [ ] Include flat-tariff, variable-tariff and poor-solar scenarios.
- [ ] Compute energy cost from interval energy rather than instantaneous watts.

Start a short-lived feature/forecast-tariff branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Implement a constraint-aware scheduling baseline
issues.body:
A simple valid baseline is more useful than an untested optimality claim.

Suggested coordination: Mitko and Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Accept the agreed site snapshot, forecasts, tariffs, EV deadlines and physical limits.
- [ ] Return schedules, recommendations and estimated cost/peak/solar metrics.
- [ ] Validate schedules independently; surface infeasibility and preserve manual overrides.
- [ ] Compare against an unoptimized baseline; test cases with no saving.

Start a short-lived feature/optimizer branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Compare manual and Autopilot simulation runs fairly
issues.body:
Show where scheduling helps with reproducible evidence.

Suggested coordination: Stoyan and Mitko. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Replay identical seed, initial conditions, weather, tariffs and deadlines.
- [ ] Compare cost, peak, grid import, solar utilization, battery throughput and EV deadline completion.
- [ ] Match or account for final SOC; report unserved energy and comfort violations.
- [ ] Keep simulator Autopilot separate from hardware-control claims.

Start a short-lived feature/comparison branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Deploy the frontend and persistent backend
issues.body:
Run a stable demo with Supabase PostgreSQL and a private authenticated broker.

Suggested coordination: Jordan and Stoyan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Verify CI on develop and release branches, including migration round trips.
- [ ] Deploy web separately from the persistent API/MQTT worker; configure TLS, origins and server-only secrets.
- [ ] Apply Alembic migrations through a controlled release step; never migrate the hosted DB from PR CI.
- [ ] Verify readiness, authorized live updates, commands and reconnects in the deployed environment.

Start a short-lived feature/deployment branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Rehearse the complete demo and simulator fallback
issues.body:
The demo must survive device or internet failure.

Suggested coordination: Whole team. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Rehearse telemetry -> dashboard -> command -> acknowledgement end to end.
- [ ] Run a local deterministic simulation when hardware/cloud access fails.
- [ ] Prepare a reset procedure and a short presentation showing measured comparison results.
- [ ] Explain supported adapters, assumptions, limitations and next steps without claiming universal savings.

Start a short-lived feature/demo branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Add multi-site portfolio and switching
issues.body:
Extend the already site-scoped model after the single-site demo works.

Suggested coordination: Stoyan and Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Show Home/Workshop/Office with authorized membership and empty states.
- [ ] Cancel old subscriptions on site switch and prevent cross-site event leakage.
- [ ] Summarize costs only over comparable periods/currencies.

Start a short-lived feature/multisite branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.

issues.title: Add a second third-party device adapter
issues.body:
Validate modularity with a real supported integration.

Suggested coordination: Daniel and Jordan. GitHub assignees are intentionally unset until usernames are confirmed.

Acceptance criteria:

- [ ] Name one device/protocol and document its actual capabilities and limitations.
- [ ] Normalize telemetry/commands to the existing contract without frontend vendor logic.
- [ ] Test unsupported controls, connection loss and command acknowledgements.

Start a short-lived feature/adapter branch from develop. Link the PR to this issue and merge after CI passes.
